items.title: Protecting SSH Keys with macOS Secure Enclave
items.summary: This article discusses the implementation of macOS Secure Enclave to enhance the security of SSH keys, providing a robust solution against unauthorized access. Developers should care as it offers insights into securing sensitive credentials in a modern computing environment.

items.title: Google SWE points 48 AI agents at NASA Lidar, finds unmapped Maya pyramid in 72h
items.summary: A team of Google software engineers utilized 48 AI agents to analyze NASA's Lidar data, successfully uncovering an unmapped Maya pyramid in just 72 hours. This development showcases the potential of AI in archaeological discoveries and data analysis.

items.title: Apple has new Mac app coming to make running local AI models easy
items.summary: Apple announced a new Mac application designed to simplify the process of running local AI models, making advanced machine learning more accessible to developers. This move is significant as it empowers developers to leverage AI capabilities directly on their devices without relying on cloud services.

items.title: Greg Kurtzer's Ginux is now a userspace kernel
items.summary: Greg Kurtzer has transitioned Ginux to a userspace kernel, enhancing its flexibility and performance for developers working in containerized environments. This change is crucial for open-source enthusiasts looking for efficient solutions in system architecture.

items.title: Using voltage glitching to unleash the A100 in my mining card
items.summary: This article explores the technique of voltage glitching to unlock the full potential of the A100 GPU in a mining card, demonstrating innovative hardware manipulation. Engineers and developers should take note as it highlights the intersection of hardware and software optimization.
